'''Chadian rum''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage. In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Fenig Nabon]] promised to buy [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Controller/Legends|controller]] [[Shind]] a case of Chadian rum as a thank you for helping her.<ref name="A Credit for Your Thoughts" />
